name: Stacked bold captions
use: Default captions: two short lines under the chin, a big yellow punch word for emphasis.

name: Karaoke box
use: When the words themselves matter: each spoken word lights up.

name: White box captions
use: Clean alternative caption style for a calmer reel.

name: Title behind the head
use: Hook word or topic pinned to the wall, his head covers part of it.

name: Magazine masthead
use: One big word behind him, magazine-cover style.

name: Cover story
use: Full magazine cover with coverlines: introductions, "the story of".

name: Glass type
use: A frosted single word behind him: premium, quieter than the masthead.

name: Gravity drop
use: Letters fall and bounce behind him: playful name drop.

name: Paper collage
use: Ransom-note letters on paper, him as a sticker: "fake / not real" moments.

name: Stamp label
use: Slams a verdict down: "TAKEN CARE OF", "DONE".

name: Proof card + chip
use: Show the real thing (a raw clip, a screenshot) with a stamp, then the result chip.

name: Reference cards
use: Credit other creators: their reels pop in right to left with handles.

name: Pull into hands
use: He grabs the cards and they fly into his fists: "took the best of each".

name: Wall cards
use: Cards taped to the wall behind him instead of floating in front.

name: Prompt bar
use: "I asked Claude to...": the request types itself and turns into a done line.

name: Typed comment CTA
use: Comment-to-get CTA: a comment types itself and sends.

name: Profile card
use: Introduce himself: liquid-glass pill with avatar, handle and name.

name: Follow chip
use: Final CTA above his head, no sound.

name: Camera REC UI
use: Hook: viewfinder grid, REC dot and timecode, feels raw.

name: Dropped file
use: A file lands in an upload box: "I gave it my footage".

name: Admit-one ticket
use: Invitation or launch: "front row seat".

name: Picture in picture
use: Show the reel inside the reel (meta moments, "this video").

name: Style presets
use: Cycle looks: a card per preset while the footage grade changes to match.

name: Storyboard deck
use: Frames fan out like cards: planning, shot lists.

name: Thumbnail mosaic
use: Full-screen wall of thumbnails: "everywhere", "all over Instagram".

name: Drawn arrow
use: Point from a word to him (or to anything).

name: Chapter list
use: "In this video": steps with a highlight moving down as he goes.

name: Checklist
use: Ticks items off as he says them.

name: Icon badges
use: Icons instead of repeating words, left to right as he lists them.

name: Icon strike
use: An icon gets crossed out: "no more pauses".

name: Split-flap board
use: Numbers flip like an airport board: before/after times.

name: Chart grow
use: Bars change with his words: time spent, results.

name: Editing timeline
use: Video-editor tracks with a moving playhead.

name: Jiggle delete
use: Bad takes wiggle and pop away.

name: Tear-off calendar
use: A day tears off: "tomorrow", deadlines, daily series.

name: Background swaps
use: Rapid new backgrounds on "this, this and this", with a flash.

name: Photo orbit
use: His photos circle him, passing behind and in front.

name: Green screen reveal
use: Green plate wipes away to the new background: behind-the-scenes feel.

name: Frame break
use: He sits in a picture frame and his hands reach out of it.

name: Doodle boil
use: Sticker outline with hand-drawn doodles that wobble.

name: Vertigo
use: Background zooms while he stays still: realisation moments.

name: Split canvas
use: Light panel on top for UI or stats, him rising from the bottom.

name: Punch zoom
use: Push in on his face for the hook line, then ease out.

name: Settle on cuts
use: Every jump cut starts 4% big and settles: hides the jump (always on).

name: Digital zoom
use: HUD punch-in with corner brackets: "look at this".

name: Zoom-through cut
use: Rush into a point and land on the next shot: topic changes.

name: Pull-back reveal
use: The video shrinks into an app window: product reveals.

name: Phone mockup
use: The whole reel shrinks into a phone: "on Instagram", "in the app".

name: Grade slider
use: Before/after wipe across the frame: colour, edits, any transformation.

name: Serif emphasis captions
use: Small captions word by word; the key word lands as a big orange serif italic.

name: Font switch captions
use: Each phrase in a new font with a font-name chip and a picker: "change the font", style talk.

name: Kinetic type
use: Cut to a solid color, one big word at a time: a beat between talking parts.

name: Number roll-up
use: A big number counts to its value: "147 seconds to 44", follower counts, totals.

name: Posting streak
use: Profile card whose day grid fills (Day 0, 7, 27): consistency, challenges, build in public.

name: Take filmstrip
use: Strip of takes; the bad ones get an X, fall away and the strip closes: "it cut my mistakes".

name: Tier list
use: S to D rows; each item pops in big and drops into its tier: rankings and comparisons.

name: Menu that follows
use: White menu over an app-icon wall; the highlight moves to each item as he says it.

name: Icon flow
use: Icon, arrow, icon on the chest: a process in 2 to 4 steps ("record, notes, edited").

name: Notification badges
use: App tiles float behind his head and get red badges: "all over Instagram", busy, popular.

name: Series badge
use: Pill at the top naming the series and episode ("Ep 3"): makes a run of videos feel like a show.

name: Snap zoom
use: Motion-blurred whip onto his face and back: punchline, surprise, emphasis.

name: Headline storm
use: Tilted headline strips fly in from both sides around him: "everyone is talking about this".

name: Growth curve
use: Glowing line chart draws upward to a label: growth, more, faster (no invented numbers).

name: Zoom portal
use: A small window of another moment opens, then the camera rushes through it: "like this".

name: Frame escape
use: White frame tilts in with the world dimmed; his head and hands break out of it.

name: Chat takeover
use: Claude chat with his request and the video attached; the reply ticks off each step.

name: Studio reveal
use: Room becomes a dark studio with softboxes and an ON AIR sign that flickers on.

name: Comment notifications
use: iPhone-style notifications stack up ("commented: EDIT", "started following you"): CTA.

name: Strike-through title
use: Bold title; a red line strikes one word and the real word drops in above it: "I can edit" becomes "I can’t edit".

name: Mono caption chips
use: Uppercase monospace captions in a black bar; the spoken word sits on a blue box.

name: Wired cards
use: Full-screen: six wired cards turn red with X marks, then collapse into one card: "too many tools".

name: Cycle diagram
use: Full-screen: a ring draws around a center card and numbered steps pop onto it: a loop or system.

name: Search pill
use: Search bar types a name or URL and the button pulses: "look it up", CTA.

name: Word-by-word captions
use: Each word pops in big on its own: fast, punchy lines and the key word of a sentence.

name: Status chip
use: A small green 'Ready!' pill with a detail (download, done, saved): proof that something happened.

name: Icon per word
use: Each word of a list gets its own icon, big and centred (remove / add / create).

name: Light-flare transition
use: A white light sweeps across the frame: a glossy cut between two beats.

name: Giant single word
use: One word fills the whole frame for a beat: the single most important word.

name: Labelled image card
use: A full-screen image with a name tag at the top (a brand, a person, a place).

name: Rapid labelled cards
use: Labelled images cut back to back, each held about a second: a quick list of examples.

name: Chat takeover (variant)
use: A chat panel slides up over the frame and messages land one by one: show a real conversation with Claude.

name: Frame escape (variant)
use: A framed picture on the wall grows and fades as he breaks out of it.

name: Snap zoom (variant)
use: A hard punch-in on a beat (0.08s in, back out): emphasis on one line.

name: Headline storm (variant)
use: Headline tags stack and shake in one after another: a list of claims.

name: Zoom portal (variant)
use: A small picture grows to fill the whole frame: the window becomes the next scene.

name: Growth curve (variant)
use: A red line chart draws upward with a big number counting up: growth, results.

name: Studio ON AIR reveal (variant)
use: A red ON AIR badge flips on with a glow: you're live, the reel is on.

name: B-roll overlay
use: Footage slides into a top panel while he stays in the room below: show a clip while he talks.

name: Dolly zoom
use: The background rushes in while he stays the same size: a dramatic realisation.

name: Scatter word
use: A word's letters fly apart from the centre: a key word breaks apart.

name: Torn-paper label
use: A torn strip of paper with a line of text lands on the frame: a note or a quote.

name: Match cut
use: A yellow circle grows to fill the frame and clears to the next shot: a shape-based cut.

name: Shutter strike
use: Two black bars slam together and open on the next shot: a hard, punchy cut.

name: Screen push (digital)
use: The shot slides out and the next slides in, with a red dot-grid wipe in between.

name: Over-the-shoulder inset
use: A small rounded inset in the corner while the main frame pushes in: show the reference while he talks.

name: Dot-grid reveal
use: A red dot-grid fills the frame and a line of text appears through it: a bold statement.

name: Liquid-glass chart
use: A frosted glass card with a rising line and a big percentage: a result, a stat.

name: Knockout captions
use: White box captions with the words cut out of the box: you see the video through the letters.

name: Live markup
use: A red marker circles his face with an arrow and a scribbled word: point at yourself, "this is me".

name: Film look
use: Warm faded grade, grain, gate weave and sprocket strips: a memory, a throwback, "the old way".

name: Screenplay page
use: A typewritten script page types itself and highlights one line: the plan, the script, what he told Claude.

name: Grid collapse
use: A 3x3 grid of clips fills the frame then folds into the centre: lots of options becoming one.

name: Contact sheet hook
use: His own frames on a contact sheet; one gets circled and zooms to fill: picking the best take.

name: Keycaps
use: Chunky keyboard keys press one by one: a shortcut, or a word spelled out on the keys.

name: Picture dive
use: A photo on the wall; the camera dives into it and back out: going into a memory or an example.

name: Playing grid
use: Six reels on the wall all playing at once (push + progress bars): lots of videos, a body of work.

name: Serif stamp
use: A big serif italic word stamped on the wall behind him with a jolt: one elegant key word.

name: Grease pencil sheet
use: A film strip on a light table: two frames crossed out, one circled "keep": choosing what stays.

name: Lens ring
use: A focal-length ring scrolls 85, 70, 50, 35 while the shot racks into focus: a camera or gear beat.

name: Reel cascade
use: Reels drop in one after another into a fanned stack behind him: "all of these", examples.

name: Kicker + big number
use: A panel with a small mono kicker ("WELL OVER") over a big number counting up: a stat.

name: Full-bleed title card
use: The whole frame becomes a brand panel with a kicker and a huge title: a deadline, a chapter.

name: Version tag
use: A small "v0.4.6" chip with a live dot: it is a real product and it keeps getting updated.

name: Labelled side panels
use: Two tall labelled panels slide in from the edges (PHONE | PRO SETUP): this vs that.

name: Numbered columns
use: 01 / 02 / 03 columns rise in with a title and lines each: three steps, three bonuses.

name: UI world
use: He is surrounded by the app: a prompt types and fills to 100%, a timeline runs, the result pops in.

name: Sticky text
use: A yellow sticky label slaps on and later peels off: a quick note or claim.

name: Before + after wipe
use: A labelled line wipes across: flat "before" on one side, graded "after" on the other.

name: Depth scatter
use: A huge word deep behind him; its letters fly apart in depth: a word that breaks.

name: Question pill hook
use: A white question pill at the top: "Can Claude...?" hooks that the video answers.

name: Polaroid + sticker
use: A polaroid tossed onto the frame with a red sticker word ("spoiler."): a photo with attitude.

name: Labelled clip tab
use: A clip card with a yellow tab on its corner naming it (RAW FOOTAGE, CLAUDE'S EDIT).

name: Pixel scene: shelf
use: A pixel-art room in the top panel: our sticky-note creature walks in, cartridges drop onto a shelf, a "?" pops, a crown lands. Build any pixel scene from pixel.py pieces.

name: Rebuilt app + cursor
use: A rebuilt app window in the top panel: the cursor switches tabs, opens a reply, types it, sends it, ticks a to-do.

name: Page B-roll: GitHub repo
use: A real page (captured with tools/capture.mjs) in a browser window: the camera zooms to the text he mentions, a marker sweeps it, a circle draws, a stat card pops.
